prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1094; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a left-turn collision. The damage to the front driver-side quarter panel, bumper bracket, and headlamp assembly lines up with the impact as described by the parties. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, straightening the fender, and refinishing the affected panels, with labor hours that fit the extent of the damage. Invoices reviewed show no repeated charges for the same work. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account.
